capabilities: Create prompts in pc code blocks parameterized with {{mustache}} placeholders
Define placeholder values as static frontmatter values or Obsidian links
Resolve linked note content, including specific sections via [[file#header]]
Recursively resolve nested pc blocks using the host note's frontmatter
Copy resolved prompts into ChatGPT or another LLM
extras: The plugin resolves prompts only; it does not call an LLM API itself — resolved prompts are copied and pasted into an external chat interface.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn vault notes into parameterized, reusable prompts, so users rewrite the same reusable data into prompts for each LLM session.

relations.evidence: Copy the resolved pc block and paste it into ChatGPT or another LLM.

summary: Prompt builder that composes reusable LLM prompts from pc code blocks with mustache placeholders resolved from frontmatter and vault links.
